EXPTRACK 1.10.0

Install EXPTRACK-1.10.0.apk over your existing app; do not uninstall.

Adds Bank Balance to Add Money. Use for opening funds not already counted. Config includes readable Inter, Arial-style, Calibri-style, system and Retro fonts. Reports are on the header chart button or Config, with monthly totals, daily chart and category breakdown.

Owed to Me supports installment payments. Mistaken loans can be deleted with confirmation; deleting a loan removes its linked cash/payment history and recalculates the available balance.

Existing records, login and reminders are preserved. Update app/site together for the new Bank Balance income source.
